content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use [product_name] on a Mac OS system, or alternatively, operate it inside a virtual machine running either Windows 10 or Linux on Mac OS?
Please refer to the attached file.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on whether [product_name] can function with Mac OS. Users are concerned about either direct compatibility or running the software using a Windows or Linux virtual machine on Mac OS. The main challenge is the lack of official documentation or guidance for other operating systems or VM use, which affects the usability for Mac OS users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to work directly on Mac OS, or at least allow straightforward use through a Windows or Linux VM.
